units.english: While lacking its iconic ferrous-red color, this planet is eerily similar in conditions to the second planet humanity set foot on, Mars. The thin atmosphere of carbon dioxide, the polar ice caps, and the echoes of dried waterways across the surface all tell the tragic tale of the same fate that befell Mars in eons past.
units.raw: description `While lacking its iconic ferrous-red color, this planet is eerily similar in conditions to the second planet humanity set foot on, Mars. The thin atmosphere of carbon dioxide, the polar ice caps, and the echoes of dried waterways across the surface all tell the tragic tale of the same fate that befell Mars in eons past.`

units.english: Even though humanity eventually triumphed over the adverse conditions and made a home on the Red Planet, this near-identical world has been left totally barren, a mere afterthought in the now interstellar human civilization.
units.raw: description `	Even though humanity eventually triumphed over the adverse conditions and made a home on the Red Planet, this near-identical world has been left totally barren, a mere afterthought in the now interstellar human civilization.`

units.english: New Argentina is a world that is ideal for ranching but suitable for little else. Ranchers live as individual families or small communities surrounded by hectares of grazing land for cattle. As a result, the population is still quite low here, and the locals live isolated lives, with most families living many kilometers away from the nearest school or hospital or even from their nearest neighbor.
units.raw: description `New Argentina is a world that is ideal for ranching but suitable for little else. Ranchers live as individual families or small communities surrounded by hectares of grazing land for cattle. As a result, the population is still quite low here, and the locals live isolated lives, with most families living many kilometers away from the nearest school or hospital or even from their nearest neighbor.`

units.english: Cattle handlers here do their work on horseback, because they believe modern vehicles are more likely to spook the animals.
units.raw: description `	Cattle handlers here do their work on horseback, because they believe modern vehicles are more likely to spook the animals.`

units.english: The spaceport is on the outskirts of one of New Argentina's largest towns... which has a population of barely ten thousand people. Many of the dock workers are teenagers or barely past their teens, children of ranchers who are not drawn to the solitary sort of life that their parents enjoy. Aside from the church and the hospital, the largest building in town is "The Grange," a function hall with a sign out front advertising square dances and line dances three nights a week.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is on the outskirts of one of New Argentina's largest towns... which has a population of barely ten thousand people. Many of the dock workers are teenagers or barely past their teens, children of ranchers who are not drawn to the solitary sort of life that their parents enjoy. Aside from the church and the hospital, the largest building in town is "The Grange," a function hall with a sign out front advertising square dances and line dances three nights a week.`

units.english: The Grange is currently set up for Remembrance Day celebrations. The population inside consists mostly of the older residents of the planet, many of them likely having traveled tens of thousands of kilometers to arrive here.
units.raw: spaceport `	The Grange is currently set up for Remembrance Day celebrations. The population inside consists mostly of the older residents of the planet, many of them likely having traveled tens of thousands of kilometers to arrive here.`

units.english: New Austria is a rugged mountain world, full of snow-capped peaks and valleys so deep and so steep that they rarely see sunlight.
units.raw: description `New Austria is a rugged mountain world, full of snow-capped peaks and valleys so deep and so steep that they rarely see sunlight.`

units.english: The few settlements that have been built here were developed for mining sapphires and rubies. The sapphires found in New Austria range from blue to yellow to black to clear in color, and are used both for industrial abrasives and for jewelry.
units.raw: description `	The few settlements that have been built here were developed for mining sapphires and rubies. The sapphires found in New Austria range from blue to yellow to black to clear in color, and are used both for industrial abrasives and for jewelry.`

units.english: For centuries the locals have been trying to find a deposit of diamonds, which would sell for much higher prices than sapphires, and local folklore revolves around the prosperity that would come to this world if diamonds were ever discovered.
units.raw: description `	For centuries the locals have been trying to find a deposit of diamonds, which would sell for much higher prices than sapphires, and local folklore revolves around the prosperity that would come to this world if diamonds were ever discovered.`

units.english: The spaceport is nothing but a couple of landing pads on the outskirts of one of the larger mining villages, high up on a mountain ridge to allow easy access for starships. A few roads lead down from there to the village, where you can trade for local goods or get food from the miners' cafeteria.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is nothing but a couple of landing pads on the outskirts of one of the larger mining villages, high up on a mountain ridge to allow easy access for starships. A few roads lead down from there to the village, where you can trade for local goods or get food from the miners' cafeteria.`

units.english: By the time you have walked to the center of the town, several people have already tried to sell you large "diamonds" that you strongly suspect are just clear sapphires.
units.raw: spaceport `	By the time you have walked to the center of the town, several people have already tried to sell you large "diamonds" that you strongly suspect are just clear sapphires.`

units.english: The village itself is abuzz for Remembrance Day. Various exhibits have been set up, displaying either replicas of the planet's largest sapphires, or the real deals. You recall seeing a cheesy Remembrance Day movie about a heist for one such sapphire when you were younger.
units.raw: spaceport `	The village itself is abuzz for Remembrance Day. Various exhibits have been set up, displaying either replicas of the planet's largest sapphires, or the real deals. You recall seeing a cheesy Remembrance Day movie about a heist for one such sapphire when you were younger.`

units.english: New Boston is a completely unremarkable world. Most of its land is wet and marshy, and the coastal regions are prone to flooding. The planet's economy is largely agricultural; some of the farms here grow food for export to Earth and elsewhere, but most farmland is dedicated to fiber crops, destined for processing in the textile mills of the spaceport city.
units.raw: description `New Boston is a completely unremarkable world. Most of its land is wet and marshy, and the coastal regions are prone to flooding. The planet's economy is largely agricultural; some of the farms here grow food for export to Earth and elsewhere, but most farmland is dedicated to fiber crops, destined for processing in the textile mills of the spaceport city.`

units.english: New Boston is a completely unremarkable world... except, of course, for the fact that you happen to have been born here.
units.raw: description `New Boston is a completely unremarkable world... except, of course, for the fact that you happen to have been born here.`

units.english: Most of the land is wet and marshy, and the coastal regions are prone to flooding. Some food crops are grown here, but most of the farmers instead plant flax and jute, which grow well in wet soil and are used to make linen and burlap cloth. The textile mills are hot and poorly ventilated, but they offer higher and more reliable income than farming.
units.raw: description `	Most of the land is wet and marshy, and the coastal regions are prone to flooding. Some food crops are grown here, but most of the farmers instead plant flax and jute, which grow well in wet soil and are used to make linen and burlap cloth. The textile mills are hot and poorly ventilated, but they offer higher and more reliable income than farming.`

units.english: Someday New Boston may be a prosperous enough planet to afford a better spaceport, but not yet. Many of the concrete landing pads have sunk into the muddy soil over the years since they were poured, and are now tilted and uneven.
units.raw: spaceport `Someday New Boston may be a prosperous enough planet to afford a better spaceport, but not yet. Many of the concrete landing pads have sunk into the muddy soil over the years since they were poured, and are now tilted and uneven.`

units.english: New Boston's shabby spaceport is about as basic as a spaceport can be. Many of the concrete landing pads are tilted and uneven, sunken into the muddy soil over time, and you have to be careful when touching down.
units.raw: spaceport `New Boston's shabby spaceport is about as basic as a spaceport can be. Many of the concrete landing pads are tilted and uneven, sunken into the muddy soil over time, and you have to be careful when touching down.`

units.english: The market where ship captains buy and sell cargo is a large tent rather than a permanent building, but it is sturdy enough to keep off the rain. Loads are brought in and out by trucks and the occasional hovercraft. Here some enterprising local mechanics have set up not only a repair shop and outfitter, but also a shipyard with several small, refurbished ships for sale.
units.raw: spaceport `	The market where ship captains buy and sell cargo is a large tent rather than a permanent building, but it is sturdy enough to keep off the rain. Loads are brought in and out by trucks and the occasional hovercraft. Here some enterprising local mechanics have set up not only a repair shop and outfitter, but also a shipyard with several small, refurbished ships for sale.`

units.english: A smaller tent has been set up beside the market. Inside are various pamphlets for Remembrance Day events occurring on New Boston.
units.raw: spaceport `	A smaller tent has been set up beside the market. Inside are various pamphlets for Remembrance Day events occurring on New Boston.`

units.english: New Britain is one of the few worlds in the Dirt Belt region of the galaxy that is relatively prosperous and has a large population. Although the gravity here is slightly low, it is otherwise a nearly ideal Earth-like world, rich enough in natural resources that all the raw materials for the local industry can come from on-planet.
units.raw: description `New Britain is one of the few worlds in the Dirt Belt region of the galaxy that is relatively prosperous and has a large population. Although the gravity here is slightly low, it is otherwise a nearly ideal Earth-like world, rich enough in natural resources that all the raw materials for the local industry can come from on-planet.`

units.english: Among the native life forms, the most striking are the many species of large and colorful birds, most of which have learned to give the cities and the spaceport a wide berth.
units.raw: description `	Among the native life forms, the most striking are the many species of large and colorful birds, most of which have learned to give the cities and the spaceport a wide berth.`

units.english: The spaceport is a granite ziggurat, a step pyramid with landing pads and hangars on each level. On the top levels are the dining areas and meeting rooms for corporate visitors; the lower floors provide warehouse and storage space.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is a granite ziggurat, a step pyramid with landing pads and hangars on each level. On the top levels are the dining areas and meeting rooms for corporate visitors; the lower floors provide warehouse and storage space.`

units.english: Compared to the relatively traditional architecture of the city nearby, the spaceport looks out of place, even absurd. But to the locals, it is meant as a clear display to visitors that even though they are in a region of space known for poor and sparsely populated worlds, this particular world is far more developed.
units.raw: spaceport `	Compared to the relatively traditional architecture of the city nearby, the spaceport looks out of place, even absurd. But to the locals, it is meant as a clear display to visitors that even though they are in a region of space known for poor and sparsely populated worlds, this particular world is far more developed.`

units.english: In celebration of Remembrance Day, the night sky above the port is densely occupied by choreographed drone formations, starship stunt flying, and firework showcases.
units.raw: spaceport `	In celebration of Remembrance Day, the night sky above the port is densely occupied by choreographed drone formations, starship stunt flying, and firework showcases.`

units.english: In the very early days of hyperspace travel, most settlers chose to put down roots within a few jumps of Earth, because until more fuel depots were built, colonies farther out would seldom be visited by cargo ships. As a result, a lot of effort was put into terraforming and developing worlds that would have been passed over by most colonists today.
units.raw: description `In the very early days of hyperspace travel, most settlers chose to put down roots within a few jumps of Earth, because until more fuel depots were built, colonies farther out would seldom be visited by cargo ships. As a result, a lot of effort was put into terraforming and developing worlds that would have been passed over by most colonists today.`

units.english: New China is one such world, and it is now overpopulated, and poor enough that maintaining the terraforming equipment and climate requires almost a third of the planetary government's tax income.
units.raw: description `	New China is one such world, and it is now overpopulated, and poor enough that maintaining the terraforming equipment and climate requires almost a third of the planetary government's tax income.`

units.english: The "new port" here was built several centuries ago, when the grand but impractical spaceport built by the original settlers had deteriorated to the point where it was no longer usable. This port is much simpler by comparison: just a ring of landing pads of various sizes around a large central building with ten levels of warehouse space accessible by freight elevator.
units.raw: spaceport `The "new port" here was built several centuries ago, when the grand but impractical spaceport built by the original settlers had deteriorated to the point where it was no longer usable. This port is much simpler by comparison: just a ring of landing pads of various sizes around a large central building with ten levels of warehouse space accessible by freight elevator.`

units.english: There are always locals hanging around the port, some of them mere children, who are trying to find a cheap ride off-planet.
units.raw: spaceport `	There are always locals hanging around the port, some of them mere children, who are trying to find a cheap ride off-planet.`

units.english: Due to complex atmospheric currents and swiftly changing seasons, the surface of New Finding is constantly scoured by powerful winds, making it difficult for soil to accumulate except in sheltered canyons and gorges. Each of these patches of greenery stands like an island amid a sea of bare rock. Over time, where the forests are able to take hold and grow, they spread outward and begin to turn more of the rock into habitable soil. On the exposed slopes, rock slides are a constant danger.
units.raw: description `Due to complex atmospheric currents and swiftly changing seasons, the surface of New Finding is constantly scoured by powerful winds, making it difficult for soil to accumulate except in sheltered canyons and gorges. Each of these patches of greenery stands like an island amid a sea of bare rock. Over time, where the forests are able to take hold and grow, they spread outward and begin to turn more of the rock into habitable soil. On the exposed slopes, rock slides are a constant danger.`

units.english: Due to the limited habitable land, the local economy focuses on high tech medicine and equipment that can be produced by relatively small laboratories.
units.raw: description `	Due to the limited habitable land, the local economy focuses on high tech medicine and equipment that can be produced by relatively small laboratories.`

units.english: The New Finding spaceport is in a canyon, with hangars cut into both the canyon walls and delicate covered bridges linking them together. Attempting to land here without crashing into anything is a harrowing experience.
units.raw: spaceport `The New Finding spaceport is in a canyon, with hangars cut into both the canyon walls and delicate covered bridges linking them together. Attempting to land here without crashing into anything is a harrowing experience.`

units.english: The bottom of the canyon is a bright green ribbon of trees and plants that stands out in sharp contrast against the red and yellow layers of sandstone.
units.raw: spaceport `	The bottom of the canyon is a bright green ribbon of trees and plants that stands out in sharp contrast against the red and yellow layers of sandstone.`

units.english: New Greenland was first settled about six hundred years ago, at the peak of the "Turf Wars" era where most planets were controlled by powerful corporations and their struggles often turned into outright warfare with privately owned fleets and armies. The people who came to New Greenland were looking for a world so marginal and undesirable that they could live here in peace without being caught in the crossfire.
units.raw: description `New Greenland was first settled about six hundred years ago, at the peak of the "Turf Wars" era where most planets were controlled by powerful corporations and their struggles often turned into outright warfare with privately owned fleets and armies. The people who came to New Greenland were looking for a world so marginal and undesirable that they could live here in peace without being caught in the crossfire.`

units.english: The locals here grow food in greenhouses and specialize in making warm winter clothing, which is this planet's only export.
units.raw: description `	The locals here grow food in greenhouses and specialize in making warm winter clothing, which is this planet's only export.`

units.english: The spaceport is near the equator, but it is still cold enough that there is always some snow on the ground.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is near the equator, but it is still cold enough that there is always some snow on the ground.`

units.english: You have never seen as many people in fur coats as there are here; what might be considered a luxury elsewhere is a necessity here, where the cheapest clothing material is the pelts of indigenous animals.
units.raw: spaceport `	You have never seen as many people in fur coats as there are here; what might be considered a luxury elsewhere is a necessity here, where the cheapest clothing material is the pelts of indigenous animals.`

units.english: From the size of the claws hanging decoratively off some of the coats, you have to give a grudging respect to the hunters. High fashion is not an industry that usually involves risk of dismemberment.
units.raw: spaceport `	From the size of the claws hanging decoratively off some of the coats, you have to give a grudging respect to the hunters. High fashion is not an industry that usually involves risk of dismemberment.`

units.english: New Greenland was one of the worlds occupied during the Alpha Wars. Despite this, Remembrance Day celebrations on New Greenland are quite humble, with most simply going about business as usual.
units.raw: spaceport `	New Greenland was one of the worlds occupied during the Alpha Wars. Despite this, Remembrance Day celebrations on New Greenland are quite humble, with most simply going about business as usual.`

units.english: Like its namesake on ancient Earth, New Holland is a world of oceans and low country. It is an old planet, its tectonic activity long since silenced, worn smooth by eons of weather. For those who live here, flooding is a constant threat, requiring a vast network of dikes and levees. But the floods also refresh the soil, making this one of the most fertile farming worlds in the region.
units.raw: description `Like its namesake on ancient Earth, New Holland is a world of oceans and low country. It is an old planet, its tectonic activity long since silenced, worn smooth by eons of weather. For those who live here, flooding is a constant threat, requiring a vast network of dikes and levees. But the floods also refresh the soil, making this one of the most fertile farming worlds in the region.`

units.english: As the population has boomed, and as the farms have been consolidated and become more mechanized, large cities have grown to house factories and workers.
units.raw: description `	As the population has boomed, and as the farms have been consolidated and become more mechanized, large cities have grown to house factories and workers.`

units.english: The spaceport is on the fringes of one of the factory towns. In the distance are row after row of identical brick buildings; in the opposite direction, a safe distance from the city, are the cooling towers of several nuclear power plants. The port itself is laid out for maximum efficiency in loading and unloading cargo regardless of the weather or time of day: a row of hangars, open at one side to ships coming in and departing, and on the other to a road carrying a steady stream of trucks.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is on the fringes of one of the factory towns. In the distance are row after row of identical brick buildings; in the opposite direction, a safe distance from the city, are the cooling towers of several nuclear power plants. The port itself is laid out for maximum efficiency in loading and unloading cargo regardless of the weather or time of day: a row of hangars, open at one side to ships coming in and departing, and on the other to a road carrying a steady stream of trucks.`

units.english: Modest Remembrance Day decorations have been set up around the spaceport, along with a sampling of the planet's produce. In the distance, you can see marginally more lavish decorations set up within the main city.
units.raw: spaceport `	Modest Remembrance Day decorations have been set up around the spaceport, along with a sampling of the planet's produce. In the distance, you can see marginally more lavish decorations set up within the main city.`

units.english: New Iceland is a perpetually hazy volcanic world, with a slightly caustic atmosphere but enough reserves of metal and petrochemicals to draw a large number of settlers. Some of those settlers also make a living as farmers, and a few well-developed factory towns produce goods for export to other worlds.
units.raw: description `New Iceland is a perpetually hazy volcanic world, with a slightly caustic atmosphere but enough reserves of metal and petrochemicals to draw a large number of settlers. Some of those settlers also make a living as farmers, and a few well-developed factory towns produce goods for export to other worlds.`

units.english: Many of the inhabitants wear dust masks to avoid letting the particulate matter from the volcanoes accumulate in their lungs.
units.raw: description `	Many of the inhabitants wear dust masks to avoid letting the particulate matter from the volcanoes accumulate in their lungs.`

units.english: Almost as soon as you stepped off your ship, your eyes began to sting. You try to breathe as shallowly as possible.
units.raw: spaceport `Almost as soon as you stepped off your ship, your eyes began to sting. You try to breathe as shallowly as possible.`

units.english: This port consists of a single large hangar, only big enough for two or three Bulk Freighters, plus some overflow landing pads and old rusted storage sheds outside. There is a small cafeteria, offering you a choice between two kinds of soup, some pre-made sandwiches, or the hot meal of the day.
units.raw: spaceport `	This port consists of a single large hangar, only big enough for two or three Bulk Freighters, plus some overflow landing pads and old rusted storage sheds outside. There is a small cafeteria, offering you a choice between two kinds of soup, some pre-made sandwiches, or the hot meal of the day.`

units.english: The caustic climate makes it difficult for the local populace to celebrate Remembrance Day properly, though a small entourage has gathered in the cafeteria regardless.
units.raw: spaceport `	The caustic climate makes it difficult for the local populace to celebrate Remembrance Day properly, though a small entourage has gathered in the cafeteria regardless.`

units.english: New India was first settled less than a century ago, and the settlers are still struggling to establish themselves. It is a hospitable climate, but the amount of labor needed to clear forests and to plow rocky fields has meant that the towns here can only grow very slowly.
units.raw: description `New India was first settled less than a century ago, and the settlers are still struggling to establish themselves. It is a hospitable climate, but the amount of labor needed to clear forests and to plow rocky fields has meant that the towns here can only grow very slowly.`

units.english: The farms grow both food crops and cotton, and very recently they have begun manufacturing their own textiles instead of just shipping the raw cotton off-world for processing.
units.raw: description `	The farms grow both food crops and cotton, and very recently they have begun manufacturing their own textiles instead of just shipping the raw cotton off-world for processing.`

units.english: New India's spaceport is a ring of low wooden buildings around a wide landing area paved with concrete slabs. Around the perimeter carts of trade goods are driven, some being pulled by tractors and others, by horses or oxen. You even think you see a few carts being pulled by water buffalo.
units.raw: spaceport `New India's spaceport is a ring of low wooden buildings around a wide landing area paved with concrete slabs. Around the perimeter carts of trade goods are driven, some being pulled by tractors and others, by horses or oxen. You even think you see a few carts being pulled by water buffalo.`

units.english: Most of the buildings are for storage, but from somewhere nearby you can smell fresh-baked bread.
units.raw: spaceport `	Most of the buildings are for storage, but from somewhere nearby you can smell fresh-baked bread.`

units.english: Despite the relative recency of settlement, Remembrance Day celebrations appear to be occurring, with Alpha Wars ballads audible from one of the spaceport buildings.
units.raw: spaceport `	Despite the relative recency of settlement, Remembrance Day celebrations appear to be occurring, with Alpha Wars ballads audible from one of the spaceport buildings.`

units.english: Wool clothing is considered a luxury in most of human space, because enough oil is mined on most planets to make synthetic clothing much cheaper than raising and shearing sheep. However, here on New Kansas, wool is the primary industry.
units.raw: description `Wool clothing is considered a luxury in most of human space, because enough oil is mined on most planets to make synthetic clothing much cheaper than raising and shearing sheep. However, here on New Kansas, wool is the primary industry.`

units.english: The land is mostly rolling green hills and shallow streams, ideal for grazing. However, unwary travelers hiking through the idyllic countryside have been known to be attacked by savage packs of feral sheep, so this world is not without unique dangers of its own.
units.raw: description `	The land is mostly rolling green hills and shallow streams, ideal for grazing. However, unwary travelers hiking through the idyllic countryside have been known to be attacked by savage packs of feral sheep, so this world is not without unique dangers of its own.`

units.english: The spaceport includes several stores selling wool garments, each worth easily ten times as much as the clothes you are wearing. A few of the visitors milling around seem genuinely interested in the clothing, but most of them, like you, are just ship captains who see wool clothing as nothing more than a pricey luxury good that can be sold elsewhere for a good profit.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport includes several stores selling wool garments, each worth easily ten times as much as the clothes you are wearing. A few of the visitors milling around seem genuinely interested in the clothing, but most of them, like you, are just ship captains who see wool clothing as nothing more than a pricey luxury good that can be sold elsewhere for a good profit.`

units.english: In the western part of the spaceport, you can see several people showing off knitted Remembrance Day memorabilia, both for sale and personal display.
units.raw: spaceport `	In the western part of the spaceport, you can see several people showing off knitted Remembrance Day memorabilia, both for sale and personal display.`

units.english: The port authority employs several people on horseback whose sole job is to keep the landing pads clear of wild sheep.
units.raw: spaceport `	The port authority employs several people on horseback whose sole job is to keep the landing pads clear of wild sheep.`

units.english: New Portland is a cloudy planet orbiting a dim star; the only reason it is not completely frozen is because of the heat trapped by its upper atmosphere. There are only a handful of towns here, and nothing big enough to warrant being called a city. Most of the settlers are subsistence farmers who can only dream about life on other worlds. Many houses here do not even have running water or personal computers.
units.raw: description `New Portland is a cloudy planet orbiting a dim star; the only reason it is not completely frozen is because of the heat trapped by its upper atmosphere. There are only a handful of towns here, and nothing big enough to warrant being called a city. Most of the settlers are subsistence farmers who can only dream about life on other worlds. Many houses here do not even have running water or personal computers.`

units.english: Some of the farms near the spaceport are planted with different crops forming abstract patterns visible from the air. Such a whimsical extravagance seems particularly odd when you consider that the owners will never be able to afford to see their fields from that angle. But perhaps that is precisely the point.
units.raw: description `	Some of the farms near the spaceport are planted with different crops forming abstract patterns visible from the air. Such a whimsical extravagance seems particularly odd when you consider that the owners will never be able to afford to see their fields from that angle. But perhaps that is precisely the point.`

units.english: The largest town on New Portland has set aside a landing area for ships, but it is barely what could be called a spaceport. Aside from the refueling station and a few sheds, there are no other buildings, just an open field of packed gravel, with grass and weeds peeking up in places where it has avoided the blast from landing spacecraft. A few farmers have parked wagons here and are trading food and other goods with the visiting ships.
units.raw: spaceport `The largest town on New Portland has set aside a landing area for ships, but it is barely what could be called a spaceport. Aside from the refueling station and a few sheds, there are no other buildings, just an open field of packed gravel, with grass and weeds peeking up in places where it has avoided the blast from landing spacecraft. A few farmers have parked wagons here and are trading food and other goods with the visiting ships.`

units.english: It appears that the spaceport has not been embellished for Remembrance Day. The main celebrations are likely taking place in the planet's individual towns.
units.raw: spaceport `	It appears that the spaceport has not been embellished for Remembrance Day. The main celebrations are likely taking place in the planet's individual towns.`

units.english: New Sahara is mostly desert and savanna, with very little precipitation.
units.raw: description `New Sahara is mostly desert and savanna, with very little precipitation.`

units.english: A century ago, some entrepreneurs settled here and built a factory complex that is entirely powered by wind and solar energy, because there are so few cloudy days here and the wind and sunshine are so reliable. The factory is mostly autonomous, with only a few thousand people living here to perform maintenance or to grow crops in irrigated fields.
units.raw: description `	A century ago, some entrepreneurs settled here and built a factory complex that is entirely powered by wind and solar energy, because there are so few cloudy days here and the wind and sunshine are so reliable. The factory is mostly autonomous, with only a few thousand people living here to perform maintenance or to grow crops in irrigated fields.`

units.english: The spaceport consists of a few large concrete slabs, each big enough for a dozen small ships or a pair of Bulk Freighters to land on. Farther away are fields of solar panels and the factories that they power. The spaceport buildings themselves, however, are underground, where less energy is needed to keep the air cool. Light pipes bring sunlight down from the surface to illuminate the subterranean storage caverns and living quarters, while keeping the searing heat of the sunlight out.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport consists of a few large concrete slabs, each big enough for a dozen small ships or a pair of Bulk Freighters to land on. Farther away are fields of solar panels and the factories that they power. The spaceport buildings themselves, however, are underground, where less energy is needed to keep the air cool. Light pipes bring sunlight down from the surface to illuminate the subterranean storage caverns and living quarters, while keeping the searing heat of the sunlight out.`

units.english: The living quarters have been modestly decorated for Remembrance Day, with ceremonial flags displayed inside the dining hall and Alpha Wars medals set up along a corridor, each one belonging to an ancestor of those who immigrated here.
units.raw: spaceport `	The living quarters have been modestly decorated for Remembrance Day, with ceremonial flags displayed inside the dining hall and Alpha Wars medals set up along a corridor, each one belonging to an ancestor of those who immigrated here.`

units.english: New Switzerland is a world where tectonic activity has left deeply folded and fractured mountains across much of the planet's surface.
units.raw: description `New Switzerland is a world where tectonic activity has left deeply folded and fractured mountains across much of the planet's surface.`

units.english: In many places, the topsoil is too thin and rocky to support farming, but many people have settled here anyway, drawn to the beauty of the mountains. A few ski resorts operate in the mountains, and in recent years a gemstone mining industry has begun to develop as well.
units.raw: description `	In many places, the topsoil is too thin and rocky to support farming, but many people have settled here anyway, drawn to the beauty of the mountains. A few ski resorts operate in the mountains, and in recent years a gemstone mining industry has begun to develop as well.`

units.english: The spaceport is in a valley, surrounded by mountains so high that their tops are often lost in the clouds. From the port town, tourists can ride a cog railway to the tops of several of the tallest mountains nearby.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is in a valley, surrounded by mountains so high that their tops are often lost in the clouds. From the port town, tourists can ride a cog railway to the tops of several of the tallest mountains nearby.`

units.english: Most of the buildings in town are wood framed, and some are old fashioned half-timber buildings with whitewashed plaster packed in between the beams. It is not a technologically advanced world, but it is a very beautiful place.
units.raw: spaceport `	Most of the buildings in town are wood framed, and some are old fashioned half-timber buildings with whitewashed plaster packed in between the beams. It is not a technologically advanced world, but it is a very beautiful place.`

units.english: New Tibet is a world of jagged mountains and deeply shadowed valleys.
units.raw: description `New Tibet is a world of jagged mountains and deeply shadowed valleys.`

units.english: Although it has been inhabited for centuries, in many places the terrain is so rugged that roads cannot be built, leaving several of the smaller towns almost completely isolated. Taking advantage of this isolation, several orders of Buddhist monks have built monasteries here.
units.raw: description `	Although it has been inhabited for centuries, in many places the terrain is so rugged that roads cannot be built, leaving several of the smaller towns almost completely isolated. Taking advantage of this isolation, several orders of Buddhist monks have built monasteries here.`

units.english: In the lowlands, large farms support sprawling cities full of factories, a striking contrast to the simplicity and isolation of the mountain villages.
units.raw: description `	In the lowlands, large farms support sprawling cities full of factories, a striking contrast to the simplicity and isolation of the mountain villages.`

units.english: The spaceport is in a hilly region, just outside of the largest city, with a view of a valley full of farms that stretch for tens of kilometers, all the way down to the ocean.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is in a hilly region, just outside of the largest city, with a view of a valley full of farms that stretch for tens of kilometers, all the way down to the ocean.`

units.english: The port is much less modern than the city nearby; it was built by the early settlers and has not been significantly updated since then, because the focus has been on improving life for the locals, not for their occasional visitors.
units.raw: spaceport `	The port is much less modern than the city nearby; it was built by the early settlers and has not been significantly updated since then, because the focus has been on improving life for the locals, not for their occasional visitors.`

units.english: Befitting their isolationist stance, the port has not been dolled up for Remembrance Day, though you are able to make out a celebration taking place in the city below.
units.raw: spaceport `	Befitting their isolationist stance, the port has not been dolled up for Remembrance Day, though you are able to make out a celebration taking place in the city below.`

units.english: A planet of violent storms and frequent earthquakes, New Tortuga does not have a lot to offer the average spacefarer. The most significant settlements on the planet are built predominantly underground, far from any fault lines, with only obscure, hardened access areas. Combined with the fortress-like blast doors that blockade the spaceport entrances, New Tortuga is the perfect place for those looking for somewhere to hide.
units.raw: description `A planet of violent storms and frequent earthquakes, New Tortuga does not have a lot to offer the average spacefarer. The most significant settlements on the planet are built predominantly underground, far from any fault lines, with only obscure, hardened access areas. Combined with the fortress-like blast doors that blockade the spaceport entrances, New Tortuga is the perfect place for those looking for somewhere to hide.`

units.english: Most of the inhabitants of this planet are Syndicate dissidents who mainly support themselves through manufacturing. The Syndicate often destroys pirate factories at their borders, but their fleets do not find the monetary cost of venturing as far as New Tortuga worth the benefit. Here, shipyards, factories, and outfitters provide a continuous supply of goods and services for the system.
units.raw: description `	Most of the inhabitants of this planet are Syndicate dissidents who mainly support themselves through manufacturing. The Syndicate often destroys pirate factories at their borders, but their fleets do not find the monetary cost of venturing as far as New Tortuga worth the benefit. Here, shipyards, factories, and outfitters provide a continuous supply of goods and services for the system.`

units.english: As you walk through the spaceport, scattered amidst the bars and black-markets, you notice a surprising number of religious buildings. There are a variety of churches, synagogues, mosques, temples, and others you can't quite remember the names of. Most of the shops are run not by pirates, but by ordinary folk, many wearing religious garb. The citizens here interact with pirates with friendliness and warmth, rather than the hostility and fear you see on other pirate worlds.
units.raw: spaceport `As you walk through the spaceport, scattered amidst the bars and black-markets, you notice a surprising number of religious buildings. There are a variety of churches, synagogues, mosques, temples, and others you can't quite remember the names of. Most of the shops are run not by pirates, but by ordinary folk, many wearing religious garb. The citizens here interact with pirates with friendliness and warmth, rather than the hostility and fear you see on other pirate worlds.`

units.english: The relative peace is frequently broken by a pirate band wandering through the spaceport. While perhaps an auditory nuisance, the pirates here are generally more obedient and disciplined than those seen on other planets. Their ships are more advanced too, judging by the armaments and engines you noticed in the hangar.
units.raw: spaceport `	The relative peace is frequently broken by a pirate band wandering through the spaceport. While perhaps an auditory nuisance, the pirates here are generally more obedient and disciplined than those seen on other planets. Their ships are more advanced too, judging by the armaments and engines you noticed in the hangar.`

units.english: New Wales is home to a few mining outposts which extract and refine rare earth minerals and heavy metals. It is dangerous work: the mines are deep underground and prone to noxious gases and cave-ins, and the refineries work with molten radioactive materials and caustic chemicals.
units.raw: description `New Wales is home to a few mining outposts which extract and refine rare earth minerals and heavy metals. It is dangerous work: the mines are deep underground and prone to noxious gases and cave-ins, and the refineries work with molten radioactive materials and caustic chemicals.`

units.english: Due to the somewhat dim light of the star Algorel, and the cloudiness of the atmosphere, this is not a good world for farming, and the population remains quite small.
units.raw: description `	Due to the somewhat dim light of the star Algorel, and the cloudiness of the atmosphere, this is not a good world for farming, and the population remains quite small.`

units.english: The warehouses at the spaceport are kept under continuous guard due to the high value of the refined metals they contain. There are several missile silos and surface-to-air laser turrets as well; New Wales has survived multiple pirate attacks in the last decade.
units.raw: spaceport `The warehouses at the spaceport are kept under continuous guard due to the high value of the refined metals they contain. There are several missile silos and surface-to-air laser turrets as well; New Wales has survived multiple pirate attacks in the last decade.`

units.english: Within the spaceport cafeteria, however, the locals are quite friendly and excited to connect with visitors and hear news of the outside world. The cafeteria is cooking lamb stew, and the smell of it pervades the whole building.
units.raw: spaceport `	Within the spaceport cafeteria, however, the locals are quite friendly and excited to connect with visitors and hear news of the outside world. The cafeteria is cooking lamb stew, and the smell of it pervades the whole building.`

units.english: Some of the locals discuss their Remembrance Day plans in the cafeteria. One of them asks you how other planets celebrate the day.
units.raw: spaceport `	Some of the locals discuss their Remembrance Day plans in the cafeteria. One of them asks you how other planets celebrate the day.`

units.english: New Washington is a planet huddled close to a dim, red sun in an otherwise frozen system. It orbits so close to the sun that the two are locked together, with one side of New Washington continuously facing the sun and the other in perpetual darkness.
units.raw: description `New Washington is a planet huddled close to a dim, red sun in an otherwise frozen system. It orbits so close to the sun that the two are locked together, with one side of New Washington continuously facing the sun and the other in perpetual darkness.`

units.english: The only villages are in the twilight region in between, and there the settlers make a living by mining for metal and for oil, a relic of a warmer period when more life flourished here and the planet spun more quickly on its axis.
units.raw: description `	The only villages are in the twilight region in between, and there the settlers make a living by mining for metal and for oil, a relic of a warmer period when more life flourished here and the planet spun more quickly on its axis.`

units.english: In this narrow ring between the baking sun of New Washington's day side, and the endless night beyond, a few native plants and animals still flourish: weirdly colored trees and grasses, and a few insect-like creatures flying among them.
units.raw: spaceport `In this narrow ring between the baking sun of New Washington's day side, and the endless night beyond, a few native plants and animals still flourish: weirdly colored trees and grasses, and a few insect-like creatures flying among them.`

units.english: Rats, accidentally introduced by the settlers, also flourish here. A small, nearly deserted cafeteria is selling stew and mashed potatoes. You are almost certain the stew is made with rat meat.
units.raw: spaceport `	Rats, accidentally introduced by the settlers, also flourish here. A small, nearly deserted cafeteria is selling stew and mashed potatoes. You are almost certain the stew is made with rat meat.`

units.english: The cafeteria is littered with Remembrance Day memorabilia: flags of corporations from a long gone era, recruitment posters for a war that has ended, banners for a victory still ongoing. Judging by how haphazardly everything is strewn about, you assume that whoever put the decorations out must be rather lazy.
units.raw: spaceport `	The cafeteria is littered with Remembrance Day memorabilia: flags of corporations from a long gone era, recruitment posters for a war that has ended, banners for a victory still ongoing. Judging by how haphazardly everything is strewn about, you assume that whoever put the decorations out must be rather lazy.`

units.english: Newhome's gravity, climate, and geography is very similar to the Hai homeworld. Several billion Hai live here. Most dwell in large factory cities, but there are also ranches in the undeveloped areas where the Hai raise animals that are larger than elephants but produce wool similar to sheep. Shearing them is a dangerous undertaking, but their wool can be used to make excellent, long-lasting clothing.
units.raw: description `Newhome's gravity, climate, and geography is very similar to the Hai homeworld. Several billion Hai live here. Most dwell in large factory cities, but there are also ranches in the undeveloped areas where the Hai raise animals that are larger than elephants but produce wool similar to sheep. Shearing them is a dangerous undertaking, but their wool can be used to make excellent, long-lasting clothing.`

units.english: The roads in the spaceport are very wide, so that Hai ranchers can lead their massive, sheep-like beasts along them. The animals seem docile enough, but their size is alarming.
units.raw: spaceport `The roads in the spaceport are very wide, so that Hai ranchers can lead their massive, sheep-like beasts along them. The animals seem docile enough, but their size is alarming.`

units.english: Most of the shops only sell clothing made for the Hai, but a few enterprising artisans have responded to the growing human population in the spaceport district and begun making clothing for humans as well: larger dimensions, and no tail holes in the pants.
units.raw: spaceport `	Most of the shops only sell clothing made for the Hai, but a few enterprising artisans have responded to the growing human population in the spaceport district and begun making clothing for humans as well: larger dimensions, and no tail holes in the pants.`

units.english: Nifel is a cold world, with summers too short to grow most crops, and very little indigenous wildlife aside from thick-furred mammals and some migratory birds that travel from one hemisphere to the other every year.
units.raw: description `Nifel is a cold world, with summers too short to grow most crops, and very little indigenous wildlife aside from thick-furred mammals and some migratory birds that travel from one hemisphere to the other every year.`

units.english: Four centuries ago, when much of human space had been in travel quarantine for a decade to block the spread of the Rigellian Plague, it was here that researchers discovered a cryophilic bacterium growing in the permafrost that could be used to combat and eventually eliminate the plague. Some research labs and manufacturing plants still remain in operation here.
units.raw: description `	Four centuries ago, when much of human space had been in travel quarantine for a decade to block the spread of the Rigellian Plague, it was here that researchers discovered a cryophilic bacterium growing in the permafrost that could be used to combat and eventually eliminate the plague. Some research labs and manufacturing plants still remain in operation here.`

units.english: The port is located near the equator, but the air is still uncomfortably cold. As with many of the fanciest buildings in the Deep, the spaceport here is built of carbon fiber and plastic composite instead of more traditional materials. The particular composite used here is slightly translucent, so the hallways and hangars are all bathed in dim and diffuse sunlight.
units.raw: spaceport `The port is located near the equator, but the air is still uncomfortably cold. As with many of the fanciest buildings in the Deep, the spaceport here is built of carbon fiber and plastic composite instead of more traditional materials. The particular composite used here is slightly translucent, so the hallways and hangars are all bathed in dim and diffuse sunlight.`

units.english: The spaceport is large enough to house ten times the number of people and ships that are currently here.
units.raw: spaceport `	The spaceport is large enough to house ten times the number of people and ships that are currently here.`

units.english: Silently orbiting its distant parent, Nilokep is a dead, airless world of stony flats and salt plains. Granite mountains jut up at the poles, but any tectonic heat this small world may have once had has long since bled away.
units.raw: description `Silently orbiting its distant parent, Nilokep is a dead, airless world of stony flats and salt plains. Granite mountains jut up at the poles, but any tectonic heat this small world may have once had has long since bled away.`

units.english: Curiously, Nilokep has an elevated level of ambient background radiation, largely due to the dispersion of pulverized granite, containing trace amounts of uranium, across its surface. While not economical to mine, it is thought that this is the remnant of some ancient geological system that eroded and dispersed the planet's primordial mountains.
units.raw: description `	Curiously, Nilokep has an elevated level of ambient background radiation, largely due to the dispersion of pulverized granite, containing trace amounts of uranium, across its surface. While not economical to mine, it is thought that this is the remnant of some ancient geological system that eroded and dispersed the planet's primordial mountains.`

units.english: Nimbus is a stormy ocean world, where a rain shower can descend on you almost without warning, only to be replaced with equal suddenness by bright sunshine. It draws mostly the sort of people who can weather such changes with placid, unperturbed calm; tourist guidebooks often rank Nimbus near the top in their lists of "friendliest natives."
units.raw: description `Nimbus is a stormy ocean world, where a rain shower can descend on you almost without warning, only to be replaced with equal suddenness by bright sunshine. It draws mostly the sort of people who can weather such changes with placid, unperturbed calm; tourist guidebooks often rank Nimbus near the top in their lists of "friendliest natives."`

units.english: All the industry on Nimbus is driven by the sea. Fish are plentiful, and the oceans here also contain some unique microorganisms that are harvested to extract useful medical compounds.
units.raw: description `	All the industry on Nimbus is driven by the sea. Fish are plentiful, and the oceans here also contain some unique microorganisms that are harvested to extract useful medical compounds.`

units.english: The spaceport is on a small island, but well above the high water mark. The mixture of ocean spray and fog and drizzling rain is enough to turn your clothes damp even just on the short walk from your landing pad to the main cluster of buildings.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is on a small island, but well above the high water mark. The mixture of ocean spray and fog and drizzling rain is enough to turn your clothes damp even just on the short walk from your landing pad to the main cluster of buildings.`

units.english: Thankfully the weather is warm, but you are glad to find a cozy, dry, and welcoming space in the coffeehouse across from the warehouse district.
units.raw: spaceport `	Thankfully the weather is warm, but you are glad to find a cozy, dry, and welcoming space in the coffeehouse across from the warehouse district.`

units.english: The Nisos Cylinder was once a huge habitat station, of the same type as the O'Neil Cylinder concept from Earth's 20th century. With a population of nearly twelve million, Nisos was one of nearly a thousand cylinders created by the Avgi, mostly in the Anax system, where they were together home to billions. As the Aberrant advanced across Avgi space, it was evacuated in a frenzy that saw most of its population flee to Aviskir. Compared to its neighbors, it is relatively intact, and still holds an atmosphere.
units.raw: description `The Nisos Cylinder was once a huge habitat station, of the same type as the O'Neil Cylinder concept from Earth's 20th century. With a population of nearly twelve million, Nisos was one of nearly a thousand cylinders created by the Avgi, mostly in the Anax system, where they were together home to billions. As the Aberrant advanced across Avgi space, it was evacuated in a frenzy that saw most of its population flee to Aviskir. Compared to its neighbors, it is relatively intact, and still holds an atmosphere.`

units.english: Located at the L5 Lagrange point of Oura, the largest gas giant in the Anax system, this habitat community had ready access to the asteroids that tended to accumulate here, which fueled the expansion and production of new cylinders.
units.raw: description `	Located at the L5 Lagrange point of Oura, the largest gas giant in the Anax system, this habitat community had ready access to the asteroids that tended to accumulate here, which fueled the expansion and production of new cylinders.`

units.english: Even if it was something other than a lifeless, metal-poor desert planet, Noluc would have a hard time attracting settlers. The angry red-orange color that coats the planet's sandy wastes is actually created by a simple neurotoxin lethal to both humans and Avgi. While technically harmless in its dry state, any exposure to water will dissolve the dust into solution, rendering it into a potent poison capable of killing with even microscopic doses.
units.raw: description `Even if it was something other than a lifeless, metal-poor desert planet, Noluc would have a hard time attracting settlers. The angry red-orange color that coats the planet's sandy wastes is actually created by a simple neurotoxin lethal to both humans and Avgi. While technically harmless in its dry state, any exposure to water will dissolve the dust into solution, rendering it into a potent poison capable of killing with even microscopic doses.`

units.english: Norn is a water world, with low gravity but an atmosphere dense enough to breathe easily. Large mats of seaweed and algae form natural rafts that drift around with the ocean currents, and a few intrepid settlers have colonized them, people who prefer a life of relative solitude and are willing to trust their fates to wherever the winds might take them. Others have settled the few, low islands, which are prone to frequent flooding.
units.raw: description `Norn is a water world, with low gravity but an atmosphere dense enough to breathe easily. Large mats of seaweed and algae form natural rafts that drift around with the ocean currents, and a few intrepid settlers have colonized them, people who prefer a life of relative solitude and are willing to trust their fates to wherever the winds might take them. Others have settled the few, low islands, which are prone to frequent flooding.`

units.english: Fish are common here, including a few species of flying fish which travel in large packs and are a considerable nuisance for the land-dwellers.
units.raw: description `	Fish are common here, including a few species of flying fish which travel in large packs and are a considerable nuisance for the land-dwellers.`

units.english: The spaceport is on one of the larger islands, a network of small buildings connected by bridges and raised up on enormous stilts about fifty meters high. Cargo winches are used to load and unload cargo from the boats that dock below. Starships dock in individual hangars, to protect them from the wind.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is on one of the larger islands, a network of small buildings connected by bridges and raised up on enormous stilts about fifty meters high. Cargo winches are used to load and unload cargo from the boats that dock below. Starships dock in individual hangars, to protect them from the wind.`

units.english: The whole complex sways slightly, almost imperceptibly, as if it were a large boat at sea. The walkways all have tall railings, but you still find yourself afraid to venture too near the edge or to look down at the island and the sea below. The locals, however, walk swiftly and gracefully, with no sign of fear.
units.raw: spaceport `	The whole complex sways slightly, almost imperceptibly, as if it were a large boat at sea. The walkways all have tall railings, but you still find yourself afraid to venture too near the edge or to look down at the island and the sea below. The locals, however, walk swiftly and gracefully, with no sign of fear.`

units.english: This binary planet is the collective seat of what are known as the New Houses, the noble families who traveled through the wormhole to this region of space during the collapse of the Predecessors' empire. Many within the New Houses object to that moniker, arguing that their family lines are in fact the more extensive and noble and that they should be categorized by that, rather than their time of arrival.
units.raw: description `This binary planet is the collective seat of what are known as the New Houses, the noble families who traveled through the wormhole to this region of space during the collapse of the Predecessors' empire. Many within the New Houses object to that moniker, arguing that their family lines are in fact the more extensive and noble and that they should be categorized by that, rather than their time of arrival.`

units.english: Despite population surges in recent years, O-Vasa-Oa remains relatively sparsely populated. The tidal forces from its binary partner create high winds that sweep across the landscape, making settlement challenging in undeveloped areas, and expensive even in those that have the infrastructure to support it.
units.raw: description `	Despite population surges in recent years, O-Vasa-Oa remains relatively sparsely populated. The tidal forces from its binary partner create high winds that sweep across the landscape, making settlement challenging in undeveloped areas, and expensive even in those that have the infrastructure to support it.`

units.english: The spaceport is built right beside a large shipyard, allowing visitors to look on at the impressive manufacturing apparatus of the New Houses while going about their business. Despite its relatively small size, the spaceport is very busy, with ships constantly launching and landing and a general air of haste among all the Successors you see.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is built right beside a large shipyard, allowing visitors to look on at the impressive manufacturing apparatus of the New Houses while going about their business. Despite its relatively small size, the spaceport is very busy, with ships constantly launching and landing and a general air of haste among all the Successors you see.`

units.english: Although much of Oasis is desert, a few tropical regions exist that are more suited to human habitation. The settlements are small, and rely mostly on agriculture, ranching, and textiles to produce goods that can be sold off-world.
units.raw: description `Although much of Oasis is desert, a few tropical regions exist that are more suited to human habitation. The settlements are small, and rely mostly on agriculture, ranching, and textiles to produce goods that can be sold off-world.`

units.english: For those who are drawn to simple frontier living, it is a paradise, where you can earn a living just by working with your hands, and where the only mode of transportation anyone needs is a horse. Many outsiders, of course, view the Oasis lifestyle as backward and primitive.
units.raw: description `	For those who are drawn to simple frontier living, it is a paradise, where you can earn a living just by working with your hands, and where the only mode of transportation anyone needs is a horse. Many outsiders, of course, view the Oasis lifestyle as backward and primitive.`

units.english: Most cargo on Oasis is carried by horse-drawn wagons. Some of them are made of steel, but others seem to be built of hand-hewn wood. The sight of horses drawing loads onto and off of gleaming starships is almost surreal.
units.raw: spaceport `Most cargo on Oasis is carried by horse-drawn wagons. Some of them are made of steel, but others seem to be built of hand-hewn wood. The sight of horses drawing loads onto and off of gleaming starships is almost surreal.`

units.english: Oberon Station is a deuterium refinery owned and operated by the Syndicate, and aside from a few docking bays for visiting ships to use in an emergency, the rest of the station is sealed off to non-employees.
units.raw: description `Oberon Station is a deuterium refinery owned and operated by the Syndicate, and aside from a few docking bays for visiting ships to use in an emergency, the rest of the station is sealed off to non-employees.`

units.english: The atmosphere here is a toxic mix of ammonia, sulfur, and methane. Although breathable by human beings if necessary, the locals use masks to reduce the risk of chronic respiratory problems. Even so, the life expectancy here is short, but that is partly because the two best-paying industries are oil drilling and mining for radioactive elements.
units.raw: description `The atmosphere here is a toxic mix of ammonia, sulfur, and methane. Although breathable by human beings if necessary, the locals use masks to reduce the risk of chronic respiratory problems. Even so, the life expectancy here is short, but that is partly because the two best-paying industries are oil drilling and mining for radioactive elements.`

units.english: The spaceport is a long landing strip paved in asphalt, with warehouses on either side of it constructed from stone and mortar. Inside are stacked lead-lined crates of radioactive materials for sale.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is a long landing strip paved in asphalt, with warehouses on either side of it constructed from stone and mortar. Inside are stacked lead-lined crates of radioactive materials for sale.`

units.english: Unlike many Dirt Belt worlds, you see few curious children watching ships land or playing among the buildings; this is not the sort of world where many people choose to put down roots and build a family.
units.raw: spaceport `	Unlike many Dirt Belt worlds, you see few curious children watching ships land or playing among the buildings; this is not the sort of world where many people choose to put down roots and build a family.`

units.english: The people of Oblivion are not particularly keen on celebrating Remembrance Day. It appears that the younger population of the planet have little concern for events from several centuries ago.
units.raw: spaceport `	The people of Oblivion are not particularly keen on celebrating Remembrance Day. It appears that the younger population of the planet have little concern for events from several centuries ago.`
